step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes: Mobile SDK (UserConsumerMobile), Public ELB (ELB), EKS (EKS), Queue (ThirdParty), DynamoDB (DynamoDB), OLAP DB (ThirdParty), S3 (S3), Athena (Athena), Private ELB (ELB).
2. Identify edges based on drawn arrows:
- Mobile SDK -> Public ELB -> EKS -> Queue
- Queue -> EKS -> DynamoDB / OLAP DB / S3
- DynamoDB <-> EKS and OLAP DB <-> EKS for bidirectional reads/writes
- EKS -> Private ELB
- Athena -> S3, Athena -> OLAP DB, and top loop back to Queue for replay.
